reasoning: The May 2013 meeting maintained identical purchase paces ($45B Treasuries + $40B MBS), the same federal funds rate target (0-1/4%), and the same threshold-based forward guidance (6.5% unemployment, 2.5% inflation). The only material language change was the addition of explicit two-way flexibility on QE pace — 'prepared to increase or reduce the pace of its purchases' — which refines the conditionality of an already-existing QE3 program rather than initiating or terminating a regime. This is a clarification of the reaction function within the ongoing accommodation regime, not a transition between regimes.
key_quote: The Committee is prepared to increase or reduce the pace of its purchases to maintain appropriate policy accommodation as the outlook for the labor market or inflation changes.
